primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文は祭司たちの一人として名を挙げ、箱の前でラッパを吹いたと述べる。
primaryTextRead.text: Shebaniah, Joshaphat, Nethanel, Amasai, Zechariah, Benaiah, and Eliezer, the priests, blew the trumpets before God’s ark; and Obed-Edom and Jehiah were doorkeepers for the ark.
